source_label.label: BUGGY_ON_SUCCESSFUL_PARENT_AND_CHILD_ALLOCATION
source_label.rationale: The separate child allocation stored at line 13 becomes unreachable when free(a) releases its sole containing parent at line 14. The parent is correctly released. Either allocation failing creates no child leak. No child dereference or repeated release is selected.
source_label.boundary: Ordinary C17 native malloc/free semantics with compatible declarations and no allocator replacement or interposition. Source-level ownership label, not an observed analyzer result or measured runtime allocation.

independence.rationale: The inspected local-aggregate training retains a separate allocation-owning local variable; here a heap parent is explicitly freed while its field alone holds the child. Member-address tests concern one allocation and mem_pool.c explicitly releases its child through caller-owned storage. These differ from the selected two-allocation parent-release/child-loss mechanism.

same_cluster_comparison.boundary: Same core ownership mechanism; no second sample or origin credit. Similarity is not proof of genetic derivation or an authenticated LLVM revision.
